title: g_tls_safe_mode is process-global: disables hash for other libraries sharing devId
description: Scenario: A shared library calls wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid() to enable TLS-safe mode. Any other code in the same process that independently uses WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID for hardware SHA will silently fall back to software SHA with no diagnostic. The maintenance consequence: users will file 'hardware hash not working' bugs that are impossible to reproduce in isolation, because the trigger is a separate library in their process setting the global flag. The header comment warns about this but the warning is on the implementation-facing helper function, not on wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid() itself which is the public API.
